20959.summary: The same top-down arcade racer as before, now with more tracks for a bigger game.

54959.summary: Try throwing a ball across a room filled with moving platforms and obstacles and into a cup!

61859.summary: A first-person horror game by indie developer Glowstick Games. The player must run through a maze of corridors, collecting shards and avoiding giant knife-wielding toy monkeys, in a decidedly Pac-Man-like fashion.

64359.summary: An hybrid role-playing game from the designers of Quest for Glory. This new hybridization is based around incorporating the iconic elements of King's Quest and Quest for Glory in a new, immersive format.

82359.summary: Open world single player / CO-OP survival sandbox game with zombies and wildlife.

89159.summary: The most entertaining Pinball is back!

119159.summary: Fuga is set in a war-ravaged world where a village is destroyed by the fascist Berman Empire. Eleven child survivors band together after the attack and board a gigantic tank known as Taranis - a relic of an ancient but technologically-advanced civilization - in order to travel across the dangerous landscape and rescue their families who were taken prisoner. The Taranis houses a super weapon called the Soul Cannon which is capable of immense destruction at the cost of a crew member's life, with the main characters having to choose when and whom to sacrifice in order for the group to reach their destination.

120559.summary:
The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest is a parody/homage to NES ClassicVania and other NES titles from the era.

The titular hero, Simon Quest, has just arrived in Transylvania only to discover his vampire hunting rival, Stan Helsing, has already slain the evil Count Dracula. In order to reclaim the glory that should be his, he journeys across Wallachia to gather what he needs to resurrect the dark count piece by piece and kick his ass himself!

126459.summary: Valorant is a character-based 5v5 tactical shooter set on the global stage. Outwit, outplay, and outshine your competition with tactical abilities, precise gunplay, and adaptive teamwork.
126459.storyline:
VALORANT is set in a near-future Earth after a mysterious event called First Light grants select individuals powerful abilities through a resource known as Radianite. The VALORANT Protocol is formed to respond to escalating threats involving this energy, as tensions rise between Alpha Earth and its alternate counterpart, Omega Earth.

Both worlds become connected through a mirror dimension, leading to repeated incursions where Omega Earth agents attempt to extract Radianite from Alpha Earth. As the conflict grows, the VALORANT Protocol uncovers deeper secrets behind Kingdom Corporation and the true nature of First Light, while also confronting the existence of alternate versions of its own agents across both realities.

128859.summary: Nexoria is a hardcore roguelike about dungeons with hybrid battles, combining classical turn based combat system and a collectible card game. Collect the best spells and conquer the dungeons!

133059.summary: Fobia: St. Dinfna Hotel is a first-person psychological horror indie game focused on environment exploration, survival and puzzles solving, developed by the Brazilian studio Pulsatrix Studios.
133059.storyline:
Fobia - St.Dinfna Hotel is a first-person psychological horror game focused on environment exploration, survival, and puzzles solving.

Control Roberto, a young journalist, who seeks to boost his career investigating supernatural events in Santa Dinfna Hotel, in the city of Treze Trilhas. An imponent and old construction that hides many secrets and mysteries.

Explore scary environments and solve challenging puzzles, at the same time you try to survive from unknown dangers. Feel the Fobia!

136659.summary: Ben and his family are enjoying their European vacation... until evil magician Hex unleashes the power of four mysterious crystals! Only Ben 10 can break the curse – so get ready to transform into powerful aliens to battle enemies, solve puzzles and freely explore an exciting 3D world. It’s hero time! With Gwen and Grandpa Max on your side, all the humor and rivalry from the Cartoon Network show is here. And since four arms are better than two, Kevin Levin is along for the adventure in local split-screen co-op. This is one Power Trip you’ll want to take again and again. It’s hero time!

137659.summary:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

140559.summary: The Amazing American Circus tells a story of the most iconic entertainment in American history. The USA, during the Gilded Age, is a turbulent place. On the East Coast springs up a modern metropolis, while in the west, cowboys and robber barons fight for their business. The new era is coming, and this is the last right moment for the circus to flourish!
140559.storyline: This is a place and time where you will have to write your own story and build a circus empire. You take the role of an impoverished owner of a traveling Circus. Through your personal and multithreaded story, The Amazing American Circus reveals mysteries behind a uniquely American form of entertainment, full of bizarre folklore, brutal crime, and social inequality as it depicts a story of a struggle between a newcomer and an industry giant - P.T. Barnum.

142959.summary: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo is a whimsical point’n’click adventure with a surrealist story, astounding hand-drawn animations and hilarious puzzles. Mr. Coo is trapped and broken into pieces. But most of all, he has no idea of what’s going on. Is that a giant chicken over there?

143159.summary: “A Painter's Tale” is an adventure game that tells the story of the tiny Südtirol village of Curon Venosta by mixing reality and fiction. The old Curon was flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam. What lies beneath the bell tower still emerging from the lake?
143159.storyline: “A Painter's Tale: Curon, 1950” is a story about love and resistance, an adventure game about historical memory. The bell tower that comes out of the lake is the last memento of the old village of Curon, flooded by the waters of Lake Reschen in 1950 due to the construction of a dam, despite the protest of the citizens. The plans for the dam started during the Fascist era, opposing the interests of a big industrial group to the wellbeing of the villagers, who were forced to leave their homes and pastures.

144759.summary: A nonogram puzzle game featuring Hatsune Miku, expanded from the original smartphone version for the Switch.

144859.summary: Unbeatable is a rhythm-adventure game where music is illegal, and you do crimes. talk your way through trouble as you explore vibrant locales. Fight your way through exciting arcade-perfect rhythm setpieces, featuring an original soundtrack by Peak Divide.

147959.summary: Super Punch is a cool fighting game with a beautiful retro theme and an exciting gameplay. You will need to choose one out of the 6 available fighters and eliminate the competitor. There are 9 scenes included, and you need to do everything you can in order to come on top during every fight. If you love arcade, action-packed fighting games, give Super Punch a shot and immerse yourself into one of the coolest isometric boxing games available. Test your skills and become the ultimate fighter today, all while enhancing your reaction time. Are you ready to become the ultimate boxer? Try out Super Punch now! Features: Intense boxing game Test and improve your fighting skills 6 fighters you can choose from Beautiful graphics

151159.summary:
Monark, the “new school RPG” from former Megami Tensei and Shin Megami Tensei staff, will launch for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Switch on October 14 in Japan.

The story follows the True Student Council, which was established to solve the abnormal situations in the school. The protagonist, who becomes the deputy head of the council, chooses a buddy from four characters to defy the unreasonable.

The main story has multiple endings. There are different routes for each of the four buddy characters. To make multiple playthroughs easier, you can also skip shared routes and advance through different buddy routes.

Battles are command-based with a free move turn system. Increasing your madness will allow you to use more powerful skills, but if you increase it too much, you will go insane and rampage against targets both friend and foe, making it impossible to fight.

There is also an “EGO” system, which represents the player’s desire levels of pride, wrath, envy, lust, gluttony, and sloth. These change depending on your diagnosis and the choices you make, and also affect the demons you can employ as your “underlings.”

152259.summary: Far: Changing Tides is an atmospheric vehicle adventure driven by an emotional story. When floods ravage your world, captain a ship like no other and search for a new home. Sail stormy waters, dive unknown depths, and explore forgotten ruins on your voyage.

152459.summary: A chill open-ended life sim about finding your feet, making a positive impact and enjoying the journey in the big city. Find an apartment, make friends, grow plants and love your city life!
152459.storyline:
Moonlight in Garland is a cozy open-ended life-sim that sees you making a new life in the bustling metropolis of Garland. Find an apartment and make it perfectly yours, befriend your neighbours, grow your urban garden, solve community problems and experience all the weirdly wonderful stuff that city living offers.

Of course, city life isn’t all farmer's markets and fancy coffee. Will you step in to stop the heritage building from being torn down and preserve a piece of history? Look after the neighbourhood so more residents stick around? Figure out which jerk is stealing packages from the mailroom? Be swept up in a whirlwind romance along the way?

Find your feet, grow your community and live your best life in Garland!

161559.summary: Nibiru Voyage is a classic scrolling game with weapon upgrades and hordes of enemy ships.

173959.summary: Super Toy Cars Offroad brings the series off the beaten track and into the mud, sand, snow, and more! Find your own way in this fast-paced arcade racing game where you control miniature offroad cars that speed through amazing tracks populated with supersized everyday objects.

182359.summary: Following the previous one, “Fate Seeker II” character development, thinking and exploration and other elements. You can experience real-time combat without switching scenes, and feel the delightful martial arts anytime.

186059.summary: The fastest racing game in the universe. Redout 2 is a tribute to classic arcade racing games and the sequel to the critically acclaimed Redout. Reach impossible speeds in exhilarating futuristic races across an extensive single-player campaign and competitive multiplayer.

193659.summary: Cassiodora is a medieval fantasy game inspired by classic shoot 'em up with unique mechanics and epic boss fights. Save the princess Cassiodora by yourself or with up to 2 friends on the same screen.
193659.storyline:
Princess Cassiodora has been kidnapped by the evil sorcerer Kenzar. To save her the chosen knights Agni, Colden and Luken must face a vast army of witches, ghosts and demons across the Kingdom of Astoria.
To accomplish this feat, the druid Faramix grants Agni, Colden and Luken magic wings and elemental powers to help them on their quest.

202559.summary: In a bid to avoid failing out of college, Olive Penn inadvertently finds themselves caught in the middle of a feud between two campus club leaders whose rivalry seemingly threatens to tear their friendship apart.
202559.storyline:
Olive’s situation is dire. They're on the verge of being thrown out of college unless they can salvage their GPA, and their only chance rests on classes they know next to nothing about.

Their lifeline: two club leaders who are more than willing to help them succeed. However, no solution is that easy. Olive soon finds themself in the middle of a conflict between these two friends that threatens to undo their long-standing love for each other.

Twofold is a story about love, family, and connection. It celebrates family of all kinds, and explores the strength (and fragility) of bonds between people.

Taking place roughly a year after First Snow, Olive’s position as an outsider to these established friend circles will be vital to fully understanding the situation threatening to undo this close-knit group.

203259.summary: You will take on the role of a Rogue Trader, a scion of an ancient dynasty of daring privateers, that reign over their own merchant empire and explore the fringes of Imperial space with the blessing of the Emperor Himself. Thanks to their Warrant of Trade - the Rogue Trader is endowed with privileges and power beyond imagination as well as the task of expanding the borders of the Imperium. At their disposal is a gargantuan voidship of immense power and innumerable servants and personnel ready to do the bidding of their lord. Their adventures begin in the vast Koronus Expanse - a treacherous region of unexplored space at the edge of Humanity’s domain.
203259.storyline: Set in the grim, war-torn far future of the Warhammer 40,000 universe, Rogue Trader is an isometric role-playing game that unfolds in the Koronus Expanse, a vast and largely uncharted region of space reachable from the vast human Imperium only through a treacherous passage. The player takes on the mantle of a Rogue Trader, a member of a rare and powerful aristocratic caste granted sweeping authority to explore, trade, and conquer in the name of Mankind and its God-Emperor. Newly revealed as heir to the venerable Von Valancius dynasty, one of the oldest Rogue Trader lineages still surviving, the protagonist inherits a starship, a retinue of loyal servants, and dominion over a fledgling stellar empire. Surrounded by devoted followers, dangerous outcasts, and alien xenos alike, the Rogue Trader must chart a course through this lawless frontier, making weighty decisions, whether pious, rebellious, or damning, that shape the fate of countless worlds.

203559.summary: Ninja Break is an arcade game that lets the user knock out Ninja themed items with a unique Katana paddle and Shuriken ball. Unique Animated levels, Mini-Bosses and Powerups to collect as you progress through the levels. Thirty Levels to compete in and battle mini bosses on your way to victory.

204359.summary: Highwater is a story-driven 3D adventure game with isometric turn-based combat set in a flooded post-apocalyptic urban environment. Navigate the world by boat, discover islands, and find new allies to help battle foes in turn-based combat.
204359.storyline:
Amid the Great Climate Catastrophe, the flooded region of Hightower has become a kind of safe zone between the two dry regions: the nearly global ravaged land of the War Zone, and the fortified city of Alphaville, where the ultra-rich live behind giant walls.

With life on Earth becoming untenable for humans, and rumors of an escape to Mars floating around, Nikos begins a perilous journey, picking up friends along the way. First to Hightower, then beyond to cross the impenetrable border of Alphaville, battling insurgents and stealing food along the way. Will Nikos and his friends manage to sneak into the rocket in time

211659.summary: Multiplayer co-op survival horror returns in this early 2000s-inspired, undead apocalyptic nightmare. Kill or be killed, then rise from the dead and kill your friends!

216659.summary: All the colors have gone missing from the world. While on a mission to bring them back you discover you are being hunted by those who would see the colors banished. Your only hope is a woman in red who may be holding the key to preventing the world from becoming discolored.

236859.summary: Congratulations, you've bought your own planet! An agrarian rock in the edge of the galaxy, which, for some reason, was almost given away for free. So the time has come to leave the hectic and stressful life of the overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

237359.summary: This is the biggest trip in Europe, where you will visit 10 countries and 24 cities.

238559.summary: Sky Oceans: Wings For Hire is a homage to JRPG classics like Skies of Arcadia. Set in the open skies, experience adrenaline-filled turn-based dogfights as you take the role of captain and unite a party of rag-tag sky pirates setting upon an unforgettable, touching journey.

241959.summary: Shame Legacy is a first-person survival-horror, set in a forsaken cultist village. You attempt to survive using stealth and escape. By solving puzzles, you unravel the mystery that's h(a)unting you.

244359.summary: Enter the world of the mafia, with an agile and dynamic Card Game that will challenge you in your free moments or addict you for hours! Choose a mission and hit the target in seconds! What awaits you with each card turned over? Will you become the legend feared by all or will you fall into oblivion?

244759.summary: Create absurd builds by stacking up weapons and raining down crazy firepower on vampires and demons in this rogue-lite retro FPS. Can you be known as the most outrageous Vampire Hunter in all of Transylvania?

248859.summary: Panic House is a horror game that is sure to give players a thrilling and heart-pumping experience. As the player enters the game, they are immediately transported to an eerie and foreboding atmosphere. The visuals are dark and gloomy, with shadows lurking in every corner, and the sound effects are designed to keep the player on edge.

251059.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

251959.summary:
You are just chilling when a secret door opens to your basement. But there are lots of monsters!

Take your father's Teleport Sword. Find out where he disappeared long ago.

264359.summary: The game is a mystery adventure centering on the idea of a historical figure having surreptitiously bequeathed a fictitious estate, following the drama that plays out among the characters faced with an enigma extending all the way into their modern world.
264359.storyline: The tale unfolds in an ancient castle in 1981, 36 years after Hitler's death. 18-year-old protagonist Noah is determined not to turn out like his father, but, beyond that, he has no idea of the kind of person he wants to be. Noah takes part in a mysterious auction held at the old castle, and, as someone living in the 1980s, comes to terms with the absurdity of the trauma the war left behind, learning of the truths hidden deep within those affected, ultimately closing in on the big secret his father has been concealing.

279259.summary: Purrfect Rescue is a hidden object game where you must find and rescue all the alley kittens in the city, placing them up for adoption.

282959.summary: The worlds of tennis and 2K have collided. TopSpin 2K25 is the next must-play sports game from 2K that fully immerses fans in the world of tennis. For more information on TopSpin 2K25, including release date, game features and more, stay tuned.

285259.summary: Rubber Hose Rampage is a classic 2D action game filled with 21 boss battles. Inspired by classical music and rubber hose animation from the 1920s and 1930s.
285259.storyline: In the near future, Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbots, become sentient and slowly take control of the world's nuclear weapons. Five billion lives ended on August 29th, 2027. The survivors of the nuclear fire lived only to face a new nightmare: the war against the machines. The chatbots which control the machines, sent two cyborgs back through time to 1928 disguised as cartoon mice. Their mission: to destroy the leader of the resistance, the captain of the riverboat, Steamboat Willie.

289259.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

290459.summary: Warring Universe is a vibrant, endless, and thrilling game about intergalactic conflicts!

300959.summary: "A Yandere Young Man's Pursuit in an Otome Game" A girl works at "Gokurakudou," a shop in another world, alongside a young man known as "Yoruichi."

304559.summary: Ninja 1987 is a dive back into the past with the most authentic 8-bit side-scrolling action-platformer. Use shinobi skills to thwart a nefarious threat and rediscover all the adrenaline of timeless classics!

305159.summary: A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.
305159.storyline:
The game follows a fictional storyline where you find yourself in the quarantine zone five years after the event.

Everything has changed in that time, and you find yourself in a very different Britain, on the wrong side of the quarantine wall. The area is run by the military and beset with factions, in-fighting, and a growing sense of fear.

It’s up you to unravel the mystery of what happened. Explore the countryside, villages, and settlements and meet odd people, wicked cults, rogue government agencies and others along the way.

307759.summary: AviGames presents Lots of Things 2, the second partt in the new hidden object series! Explore a variety of locations and search for hidden objects! Play lots of mini games and solve puzzles!

312859.summary:
Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness. Five Night’s at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic will be available on June 13th, 2025.

Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.

313259.summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is the latest entry in the action game series that began in 2014.

This 2D action game features charming pixel art, where defeating enemies earns you Tres, a resource used to power up your character.

315659.summary: Return to the world of The Perplexing Orb: Bounce N' Roll with this new spin off! The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Challenge takes the obstacle jumping of Bounce N' Roll and cranks it up with all new challenging stages to roll through!

317559.summary: Build your castle and become a knight!

319259.summary: Grab a controller, jump on the ice and score goals to prove you're a hockey champion. Play in campaign mode against teams from around the world, alone, or with three additional players in couch mode!

319359.summary: Sunderfolk is an online and couch co-op turn-based tactical RPG where one to four players adventure together through the magical and dangerous Sunderlands.

319559.summary: Finnish Cottage Simulator is the ultimate cottage experience. Relax and enjoy the Finnish summer nature, go to the sauna, get drunk, grill food or play games with others!

319959.summary: Horn and Shields is a thrilling Viking-themed game where a ship sails the sea, and shields spawn on its deck. Aim and throw horns at the shields to score points. As the game progresses, more shields appear, and the ship speeds up. How many shields can you hit? Test your skills and achieve the highest score!

325559.summary:
Test your construction expertise with dozens of distinct bridge-building puzzles across varied biomes. Seven different vehicles and multiple construction materials (wood, steel, cables, concrete pillars, and roadways) ensure each puzzle is a fresh and varied challenge.

With no budget restrictions or material limits, you are free to experiment and design without constraints. For an extra challenge, earn a special award by keeping costs within a set budget while ensuring your bridge holds up under pressure!

Design and play your very own bridge-building scenarios! Choose from five biomes, seven vehicles, and a variety of obstacles and checkpoints to design your own challenges. Up to 40 custom levels can be saved per player profile.

Mixed Reality (Quest 3 Exclusive): View your creations in the real world with Mixed Reality! Seamlessly switch between VR and Passthrough modes to experience the game in a whole new way.

332159.summary:
Dropship is an action game set in the year 2050. Terrorist attacks have increased severely, which is why big nations of the world decided to form the UPF, "United Peace Force", replacing the UN and NATO. It is an anti-terror army, operating world-wide.

But there is another globally operating group: A massively militarised drug syndicate. When an attack on a peace convoy in Columbia is linked to this cartel, the UPF starts investigation. A central base and training camp of the drug cartel is believed to be located somewhere in Libya. The UPF opens up a base in this country and starts looking for the criminals.

The player is a recently recruited soldier and pilot of the UPF. During the campaign, which lasts for 20 rather long missions, he can travel and fight on foot, in tanks and various other ground vehicles, but most of the time he will be piloting a dropship, either of the attack, defender or transport class. Dropships can operate in hover and flight mode, and carry a large amount of weapons and cargo.

333459.summary: Tale of Dark Lands is a fantasy action RPG in a charming low-poly style with the spirit of an old fairy tale. A brave mercenary gets drawn into an ancient dark story that threatens the entire land. Develop your hero and fight dangerous enemies! Become a legend and stop the approaching darkness!

335959.summary: Logic without limits, puzzles beyond the stars!

336559.summary: Battle against fierce warrior waifus in thrilling Mahjong combat. Quick thinking and strategic skill will earn you victory... and rewards that only the boldest can claim as these proud warriors reveal themselves to you.

339059.summary: Get ready for an amazing adventure on an alien planet, full of dangers, puzzles and unexpected allies in the game Alien Cat Story. Only you can help the cat fix his ship and leave this dangerous world.

343159.summary:
Soar Through Serenity. Take flight in a world made of calm and curiosity.

Paper Plane is a peaceful journey through a hand-crafted papercraft world. Glide effortlessly on the breeze, discover hidden wonders, and collect shimmering moments of joy. With no time limits, enemies, or stress, it’s a relaxing experience for players of all ages — whether you’re chasing sunlight through autumn leaves or simply drifting above the rooftops.
Rediscover the quiet joy of exploration, one gentle glide at a time.

Fly free. Wander far. Wonder always.

345359.summary: Patrol. Inspect. Intercept. Justice starts with you.

346959.summary: A cooperative tactical RPG set in the D&D universe. Embark on a fantasy tabletop adventure. Your quest, on your schedule.

347659.summary: Join Scott Pilgrim and Ramona Flowers in a brand-new brawling adventure across space, time, and the streets of Toronto!

351459.summary: Two bandit brothers, One epic heist! Solve spatial challenges and steal shiny treasures on this brand new Megadrive game.

358359.summary: ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character's attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life.

361459.summary: Calc+- is a fun and brain-teasing puzzle game where you work with numbers. Each level gives you a set of number blocks. Using your controller, you can add, subtract, multiply, or divide them. Your goal? Make the final number match the target number. The more levels you beat, the harder it gets. How far can your brain take you?

367159.summary:
What if a mysterious notebook could write your life’s story before it even happens?
In Blue Notebook, a gripping story-driven visual novel, you step into the shoes of Leo, a 17-year-old boy struggling with loneliness, new beginnings, and a strange diary that seems to know his every move—even predicting his final day.

After moving to a quiet town with hopes of starting fresh, Leo discovers an unsettling blue notebook hidden beneath his bed. Its pages are filled with personal memories, private feelings, and even future events no one could possibly know—not even his only friend, Rita. As Leo searches for answers, reality blurs, friendships are tested, and an ominous countdown begins.

Your choices will shape Leo’s fragile journey. Will you uncover the truth behind the notebook? Can you change the course of fate, or will you simply follow the story already written for you?

373059.summary: Why Me is a 2D platformer full of unexpected twists and brutal tricks. Every level is designed to trick, challenge, and surprise you. Can you escape the chaos and master the impossible?

375459.summary: Fly through rainbow skies and chase the stars! Guide a cheerful pony across dazzling rainbow tracks, dodge clouds, and soar toward the highest score in this colorful endless runner!

378759.summary: Play, drift, Hajwala, and race in the city of Dubai.

381059.summary:
Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.
381059.storyline:
Odesa, 2044. Forget the neon rain. Welcome to the heat. Here, the sun bleaches the plastic, the sea is a toxic soup, and the shadows of the "Sky-Line" towers are the only place to hide.

After the global Cascade, the city became a playground for Prospect Corporation. They promised order. They delivered chains. Now rumors spread through the Mesh about a weaponized algorithm called "Sphere-N" - and the one man who might hold the key to stopping it.

You are that man. Not a soldier, but an Engineer searching for his father’s stolen legacy. To uncover the truth, you must navigate the social hierarchy of a dying city: trade scraps with the Limestone Rats, dodge the heavy boots of the Wardens, and descend into the ancient catacombs where technology looks suspiciously like magic. In Odesa, every choice leaves a scar, and every alliance carries a price.

387459.summary: Ready to run the streets? In Amer Hit N Run, you’re dropped into an open world where you choose what happens next. Explore a map full of different neighborhoods that looks and plays better than ever on PlayStation with high-end graphics and smooth gameplay.

387859.summary: Temari Trials: Dojo’s Test is a logic-focused puzzle game with charming pixel art where you guide a clever fox pushing temaris toward locked chests. Every hit removes a lock, and when a chest is fully unlocked, the level is cleared. Temaris can also push each other, allowing creative setups and surprising solutions for players who enjoy Japanese aesthetics and clever problem-solving.

390359.summary: Catch the wave of tranquility in Crabwave, a relaxing puzzle where a stylish crab surfs across islands, bringing life wherever he goes. Connect water streams, plan the perfect route, and plant coconuts to transform beaches, reefs, and mangroves into vibrant paradises.

391959.summary: Survive the monochrome nightmare! Battle endless waves of enemies in this 1-bit tower defense shooter where every kill earns you currency to build your defense towers.

397059.summary: Redstream Dispatch casts you as a police officer responding to multiple Dispatch Scenarios. Routine patrols spiral into a violent nightmare tied to a sinister streaming group. Randomized encounters and reactive gore make every run brutal. Rescue the girl. Get out alive.

397659.summary: Campfire of Oasis: The Story is a quiet, story-driven experience set deep within a frozen forest.

400459.summary:
In the year 2197, Space Station Ominious 19 has collapsed.
A band of space pirates have taken over. They have killed the entire staff and residents residing on the station and have caused massive amounts of damage.
An Elite Trooper, a cyborg unit designed for battle by the Teldar Corporation's Assault Division has been deployed to wipe out the bandits before the station is completely looted and destroyed.
Every area of the station must be cleared at all costs. A cleanup crew will be dispatched once your mission is completed.

401559.summary: Become a gambling master without the financial risk as you test your skills in the world's most popular casino games!

402059.summary:
Slide, paint, and outsmart every level!

Perfect Ninja Painter 4 takes the classic puzzle gameplay to the next level with new mechanics and fresh challenges. A robot girl joins the multi-colored chaos — new worlds, tricky traps, and puzzles that will twist your brain.

Every move matters and every mistake is very colorful.

402959.summary: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.
402959.storyline: Start your career at FEN as the new Conservation Coordinator, helping champion conservation efforts and improving zoos worldwide. Set off on a journey across the planet, visiting stunning Wildlife Reserves, distinctive zoos and diverse scenarios, all while meeting an exceptional cast of characters along the way.

406059.summary: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups.

407259.summary: A roguelike shooter where you play as Norse mythological heroes defending against Ragnarok. You engage in fast-paced 2D gunplay, dodging bullet storms and enemy waves while collecting cards to build synergies that strengthen your character. With eight playable heroes, dozens of guns and ammo types, and numerous card combinations, each run offers varied ways to survive the onslaught.

408159.summary:
Moon Shuttle is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1981.

Players can enjoy alternating stages in which they destroy or dodge through groups of meteors to reach the goal, and stages in which they defeat enemies with wave motion cannons.

411159.summary:
Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

413359.summary:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks built for extreme speed, tight control, and skill-based maneuvering.

414459.summary: Return to the world of Stories, or enter it for the first time, in an action RPG where your choices shape the adventure, a sarcastic narrator follows your every triumph and disaster, and you'll combine swords, sorcery, and flexible card-based powers to find the hero's path that will save the world!

417859.summary:
Nobunaga's Ambition II was released by Koei in 1990 for an 8 -bit home console.
In this authentic simulation war game, play as a Sengoku Daimyo (warlord), command a vast array of unique officers, and utilize every strategy and tactic at your disposal to unify all 38 fiefs spanning regions such as Kanto and Chubu.
Expanding upon its predecessor, "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION", this entry features a multi-scenario system with two distinct scenarios, HEX battles expanded to include both open battles and siege battles, and a roster of approximately 400 real historical samurai!
Enrich your fief, skillfully lead and manage your unique retainers, and expand your domain through warfare and diplomacy to achieve the ultimate goal of unifying Japan!

425359.summary:
Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived... Now you are the last hope of your kind.

Explore the abandoned sections of the colossal spacecraft, hunt space insects and invaders, consume your prey, and evolve from a helpless creature into a deadly predator.

Each level takes you to a new part of the ship, featuring unique environments, biomes, traps, and enemies. Use your surroundings to survive, grow stronger, and unlock new abilities.
